notes.title: Patch #4: Introducing Custom Difficulty
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re back with another patch for [b]Only Lead Can Stop Them[/b]! This time we’re introducing a brand new feature: Custom Difficulty Designer which lets you adjust various aspects of the game to tailor the gameplay to your liking. We've also addressed several issues that players have reported, including boss navigation problems, minimap performance, and level-specific bugs.

Now, let’s dive into the details of what’s new in this patch!

[h2][b]New Feature: Custom Difficulty Designer[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42012077/b6cf4eca8e4ca4dfc0ea5e77396eb2b3eea197bf.jpg[/img]

We're introducing  a fourth difficulty setting that twists the gameplay in a big way. You'll now be able to change:

[b]Player Settings[/b]
[list][*] Adjust your movement speed to match your playstyle
[*] Control how much damage you can take before going down
[*] Customize how much health and ammo you receive from pickups[/list]
[b]Enemy Settings[/b]
[list][*] Adjust how tough the enemies are
[*] Make enemies faster or slower based on your preference
[*] Adjust projectile speeds for a different combat experience
[*] Tune enemy damage output to your liking[/list]
Whether you're looking for an extra challenge or make your journey a bit easier, these customization options should help you find the right balance. Have fun experimenting with different combinations!

[h2][b]FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Boss Combat[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Some fixes has been made to bosses and how they navigate the area. It fixes an issue where bosses would get stuck in certain areas and walk into walls[/list]
[h3][b]Minimap Performance[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Opening the minimap has caused severe lag for some players on high refresh rate monitors. This patch aims to fix this issue[/list]
[h3][b]Level Tweaks[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue in E2M1 where friendly soldiers were incorrectly pathfinding through the wall of the starting building[/list]

We hope you all have enjoyed playing the game so far. We would greatly appreciate a review of the game or recommend it to friends to help the game grow. 

Until next time!

notes.title: Patch #3 is live: Fixes across the board
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re back with another exciting patch for [b]Only Lead Can Stop Them[/b]! This time we’ve prepared a host of audio tweaks, especially for the shotgun, gameplay improvements, and bug fixes. The shotgun sound has been mentioned frequently by the players, and we’ve made changes based on your feedback to make it more satisfying and impactful. We’ll continue to monitor your input closely and adjust as needed.

And here’s more good news!: [b]Only Lead Can Stop Them[/b] is currently [b]15% off[/b] as part of the [b]Lunar New Year Sale[/b]! If you’ve been looking for the perfect time to bring friends into the fray or finally join the action yourself, this is it.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Retrovibe/sale/lunarnewyearsale2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42012077/715d6d257b9e8e42cfa1b7cb35cab78ff9c3fa1d.png[/img][/url]

Now, let’s dive into the details of what’s new in this patch!

[h2][b]Patch #3 Notes[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Sound FX[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The sound for firing the shotgun has been changed to a more powerful variant. This affects the player's sound when firing as well as the Carlist enemy type firing.
[*] The sound of dogs barking when chasing after the player has been tweaked to remove some high pitch noise that occurred in some circumstances.
[*] The sound of various flames from props and projectiles had some noise errors caused by settings for the sound mixing that has been fixed.[/list]

[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Some text-elements has been adjusted so to better fit certain texts in menus.
[*] Better fit for certain texts when localized to certain languages.[/list]

[h3][b]Level tweaks[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The level E1M8 has had some issues fixed regarding z-fighting of 3d-object.
[*] The level E3M1 has had some mesh gaps fixed for better visual presentation.[/list]

[h3][b]Props[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Darker wooden crates has had an error fixed where the collider would not deactivate when crate was destroyed.[/list]

[h3][b]Enemy[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] All boss enemies are now affected by the No Aggro setting which previously only affected regular enemy types.
[*] The El Gordo boss enemy of Episode 2 now faces the player at the start of battle. Also, the sprite now only rotates on y-axis to avoid minor visual misbehavior.
[/list]

We hope you all have enjoyed playing the game so far. We would greatly appreciate a review of the game or recommend it to friends to help the game grow. 

Until next time!

notes.title: Dev Update: Launch Month in Review
notes.content:
Hello, soldiers!

[b]Only Lead Can Stop Them[/b] has now been available for a month, and we thought it’s a perfect time to share some of the highlights since its release.

The game was recently recognized as one of the Top 100 in IndieDB’s Indie of the Year Awards, a testament to the strong reception from the indie gaming community. On Steam, the feedback has been overwhelmingly positive, with a 90% positive review score from players.

Our launch trailer has also made waves, surpassing 35,000 views - a number that exceeded our expectations. Many comments have highlighted and praised the influence of classic shooters - especially [b]Wolfenstein 3D[/b] and the modern boomer shooter [b]Cultic[/b].

[previewyoutube=KZU9dBJqAd0;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re grateful to everyone who has supported the game so far - whether by playing, sharing feedback, or helping spread the word.
[h3][b]
What’s Next?[/b][/h3]
Our goal is to keep improving [b]Only Lead Can Stop Them[/b] and add new features based on community feedback. Here are some of the updates we’re working on right now:[list][*] [b]Improved Sound Effects[/b] – We’ve received a lot of feedback about the audio design in Only Lead Can Stop Them, and we’re making it a top priority to improve the sound effects for weapons, starting with the shotgun. Our goal is to make weapon sounds feel even more punchy and immersive, enhancing the overall experience during combat. Whether you’re blasting enemies at close range or unleashing chaos with the flamethrower, these improvements are all about making the action feel even more intense and memorable.
[*] [b]Ultra-Wide and Aspect Ratio Support[/b] – Full compatibility with a range of screen sizes.
[*] [b]Enhanced Enemy Behavior[/b] – Improving pathfinding and combat capabilities of enemies.
[*] [b]Level Editor Updates[/b] – More building options, better performance, and improved import/export features for custom levels.[/list]
The first month of [b]Only Lead Can Stop Them[/b] has been a strong start, and we’re excited to keep building on that momentum. Your feedback and support have been instrumental in shaping the game, and we look forward to sharing more updates soon.

Stay tuned, and as always, [i]Only Lead Can Stop Them[/i]!

notes.title: Patch #2 is here: Fixing achievements, improving save system, and more!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We hope you've been enjoying [b]Only Lead Can Stop Them[/b] and thank you for your feedback since the game's launch. As we move into 2025, we're kicking things off with Patch #2, addressing several issues and bringing improvements to the game. Here's what's new:

[h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[b]Achievements:[/b]
All the achievements for completing the episodes on different difficulty should now be working and trigger correctly. These are nine achievements in total:
[list]
[*] Episode 1: Smooth Sailing, Turning the Tide, Tsunami
[*] Episode 2: Mess Sweeper, A Fiendish Mess, Viscera Cleanup
[*] Episode 3: Island Inspector, Citadel Caudillo, All your base are belong to me
[/list]
[b]Save System:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the save system failing to load boss enemy health and position making mid-boss battle saves not work as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue with dead Lizardman having water sprite active on loaded save.
[*] Fixed an issue with triggers that spawn enemies didn’t save spawning as completed so upon loading a save another round of enemies would be spawned.
[*] Addressed a rare issue where a previous level would sometimes be unintentionally loaded upon death, restarting a level or starting a new game from main menu.
[/list]
[b]Rendering:[/b]
[list]
[*] In order to fix an issue with sprites for enemies, pickups, and props having odd rotation when close to the camera we opted for a change restricting their rotation to only the Y-axis. This ensures a better overall visual experience with very little downside.
[/list]
[b]Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*] It's now possible to kill lizardmen submerged underwater using explosives. 
[/list]

Dan Pettersson

notes.title: Only Lead Can Stop Them – Devlog #3 – The Rifle
notes.content:
Militias! Welcome back to the third devlog for Only Lead Can Stop Them.

We just got back from a local event in Gothenburg where we let a few local game devs
commenting on the current state of our game and bounce a few ideas over some upcoming
features that’s in the pipeline. We where happy to hear about how some commented on
improved game feel and specially how some weapons feels very satisfying. Several of these
game devs have tried a couple of versions of the game and can compare their early game
test two years ago and one of the recuring comment was that the rifle had gone from being
forgettable to becoming their favorite weapon to use. It prompted me to want to share
some of the development history for the rifle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42012077/886bef717dcc9bcec8f63f451a3f68510c1c729c.jpg[/img]

In the early days of the game development it was decided that a game that takes place in the
Spanish Civil War needs to have a focus on a rifle for one of the main weapons. Rifles was a
very common weapon at the time making up the bulk of the arsenal of the worlds armies.
When the war broke out both sides of the conflict sought to arm themselves by
supplementing the divided arsenal with guns imported from abroad. As such there were
plenty of different rifles used during the war.

The rifle that is featured in the game is based on a variant of the French Lebel 1886 rifle
model. Of the more than a dozen rifle models used during the war several had been
designed to use the 8 mm Lebel rifle cartridge which makes the Lebel a good representation
of the standard rifle at the time.

When designing a weapon for a game there are a couple of different aspects to consider.
One of these is the need to have weapon stand out from the rest and for it to offer a unique
experience compared to the rest of the arsenal. Since we wanted there to be fast shooting
weapons in the game like the sub-machine gun and the heavy machinegun we wanted the
rifle to differ by having a slower rate of fire. This also serves as realism and immersion in the
time period since a bolt action rifle wasn’t easy to operate at a fast pace with any
meaningful accuracy.

The graphical artist Johannes Broman got to work and made the design with the detailed
animation of the player handling the action of bolt and raising the gun to take aim. The
shooting animation showed a very powerful punch and it all came together for a very nice
visual delight. Early on it reminded me to some extent of the very iconic weapons animation
of the shotgun in the original Doom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42012077/d0a40793af69719342a97a37605e2fb24a17d525.gif[/img]

The rifle was later developed further to also be featured with different animation with the
rifle grenade weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42012077/90a6af56e1f8720d3fe46c6988404a42c13fd39c.png[/img]

What few people know however is that the rifle weapon was originally imagined having a
bayonet that could be fitted at the end. Animations was made for this, and the idea was that
the player would be able to alternate between having the bayonet on or off and would use a
secondary fire key to do melee attacks. There had even been the idea that the rifle could be
stuck in wooden walls at a missed strike and an animation for pulling the rifle out was made.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42012077/95049ec26efbe2602310da74a965df32c71861f5.png[/img]

This could have been a neat feature but in the end this feature was scrapped for two
reasons. Main reason is that it made the controls more complex than we wanted to. The
second reason is that the knife looked better when animated and we didn’t want it to lose
its usefulness.

The rifle had a slow rate of fire but was one of the deadliest guns in the game. That is to say
if you were able to aim with it. The earliest iterations of the game had a delay of more than
one second from when the player clicked to fire to when the gun actually went. Many times,
the enemy had time to move out of the way. This was due to the detailed animation of the
player lifting the rifle and carefully aiming. To some this made the gun feel different and
some even liked the additional challenge that the rifle offered. Many players however
couldn’t be bothered with the hassle and opted to fire many bullet from the smg instead.

It was obvious that we had a problem here. One of the weapons we hoped would be a
center piece of the game was being passed over, so we had to fix it. We started by testing a
faster animation pace. The faster switch between sprites looked out of place however. The
next thing we did was to drop frames from the animation removing most of the lifting and
aiming of the gun. Now the gun instantly fired when the player pressed the button. And with
a few tweaks further the animation had a different feel. The more sudden raising of the gun,
when removing the gradual raising at aiming, created a feeling of the rifle having a more
powerful knock back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42012077/e1f316e3d470e7424e6bcbe1fdf2b595c6413fa4.gif[/img]

In the end we kept most of the animation that made the rifle a slow paced weapon since the
animation of the bolt action between shots still slows it down. We had however balanced
the need for graphical impressiveness with the players need for responsive controls and as a
result the rifle had become one of the best looking weapons and one of the best sources of
game feel.

[h3]Until Next Time[/h3]

I hope you enjoyed this little story of how the games rifle came to be. We hope to give you
more exciting stories down the line of current and upcoming features.

I’ll see you in the next devlog

- Dan Pettersson, creative director and tech artist

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1909100/Only_Lead_Can_Stop_Them/

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

[*]Enemies getting stuck in the ground.
[*]Some explosions having a great blast radius.
[*]Animation glitches on weapons.
[/list]

There are more improvements on the way!
